title: Don't talk about optimism in Syria, talk about action
gist: Arwa Damon's on-the-ground dispatch argues Syria's post-Assad recovery is stalling: despite removal from the US State Sponsors of Terrorism list, very little of the promised MoU money has arrived versus a $216bn World Bank need, institutions can't absorb investment, and opaque megadeals (Arada's $7bn Damascus compound) risk public anger. External (Israel-Turkey proxy risk) and internal (SAS/ISIS militancy, fuel-price protests) threats are rising 20 months after Assad's fall.

insights.claim: The US removed Syria from the State Sponsors of Terrorism list, lifting a major barrier to international investment, but donors remain reluctant due to domestic and regional instability including the war in Iran.

insights.so_what: Legal de-risking alone is not unlocking capital; instability remains the binding constraint.
